diagnosis: Train/validation gap at the best iteration: accuracy +0.136, log loss x106.3. Trees memorise the training embeddings faster than they generalise to unseen question families - classic overfitting, bounded by early stopping.
Validation log loss did not improve for 50 rounds after iteration 1265 (val loss at stop: 0.4644 vs best 0.4642); early stopping kept the best iteration.
Validation accuracy decreased on 111 of 1265 steps up to the best iteration: accuracy is a step function of argmax changes and need not rise monotonically even while log loss falls.
